name: Pipes & Tubes
blurb: Carbon, stainless and galvanized steel pipe, copper and brass tube, HDPE, PPR and PVC pipe, and stainless decorative tube.

name: Butt-weld Fittings
blurb: Elbows, tees, reducers and caps for welded lines, in carbon steel, stainless steel, HDPE, PPR and PVC.

name: Threaded & Forged Fittings
blurb: Screwed fittings from Class 150 up to 6000 PSI, in stainless steel, carbon steel, brass and copper, plus long barrel nipples.

name: GI & MI Fittings
blurb: Galvanized, malleable iron, electro-galvanized and hot-dip galvanized fittings for water, gas and general plumbing.

name: Flanges
blurb: Weld neck, slip-on, blind, threaded and socket weld flanges in carbon steel, stainless steel and HDPE.

name: Valves & Strainers
blurb: Ball, gate, globe, check, butterfly and safety valves, actuated valves and Y-strainers, threaded or flanged.

name: Camlocks & Couplings
blurb: Camlocks in stainless steel, brass, aluminium and polypropylene, plus Storz, Bauer, Chicago and grooved couplings.

name: Hoses & Flexible Connectors
blurb: Hydraulic, air, diesel, suction and composite hose, rubber flexible connectors and expansion joints.

name: Gaskets & Sheets
blurb: Cut gaskets and sheet in EPDM, NBR, PTFE, non-asbestos and high-temperature grades, plus spiral wound gaskets.

name: Structural Steel
blurb: Beams, channels, angles, flat and round bar, hollow sections and sheet in mild steel, stainless steel and GI.

name: Insulation & Tubes
blurb: Rubber, glass wool and fibreglass insulation, plus acrylic and glass tube.

name: Gauges & Instrumentation
blurb: Pressure, vacuum, compound and temperature gauges, with syphons, snubbers, needle and cock valves, and glycerine.
